item.text: {"search_note":"I found little direct evidence that Scholz personally drove formal peace negotiations on Ukraine in 2024. I found no strong evidence of ceasefire diplomacy beyond Gaza, and no visible record here of confidence-building measures in the classic arms-control sense. I did not find reliable evidence of Scholz leading direct Ukraine peace talks in 2024, or substantial evidence of formal confidence-building measures beyond his general escalation restraint and arms-control framing.","evidence":[{"title":"Joint Statement on Gaza","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"6 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/joint-statement-from-the-leaders-of-the-united-states-argentina-austria-brazil-bulgaria-canada-colombia-denmark-france-germany-poland-portugal-romania-serbia-spain-thailand-and-the-united-kingdom-on-gaza-2290942","summary":"Scholz joined a statement calling for an immediate ceasefire, unconditional hostage release, protection of civilians, large-scale humanitarian aid, and compliance with international humanitarian law.
